Trigger.Name: WHEN-BUTTON-PRESSED
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 lBatchID varchar2(10);
 al_id alert;
 al_text varchar2(100);
 al_button number;
 lCount number := 0;
begin
 if :from_date is null then
 go_item('from_date');
 show_error('0080');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;

 if :to_date is null then
 go_item('to_date');
 show_error('0080');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;

 if :printer_name is null then
 go_item('printer_name');
 show_error('0080');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;

 select count(*) into lCount
 from donor_type_hdr
 where print_start_date between :from_date and :to_date
 or print_end_date between :from_date and :to_date;

 if lCount > 0 then
 select count(*)
 into lCount
 from donor_type_print_file
 where coll_date_1 between :from_date and :to_date;

 if lCount > 0 then
 al_id := Find_Alert('Choice_Alert'); 
 al_text := lCount || ' records already exists for entered dates, want to continue?';
 Set_Alert_Property(al_id, alert_message_text, al_text);
 al_button := Show_Alert( al_id );
 if al_button != ALERT_BUTTON1 then
 execute_trigger('key-clrfrm');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 else
 al_id := Find_Alert('Choice_Alert'); 
 al_text := ' Are you sure to generate the batch?';
 Set_Alert_Property(al_id, alert_message_text, al_text);
 al_button := Show_Alert( al_id );
 if al_button != ALERT_BUTTON1 then
 execute_trigger('key-clrfrm');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
 else
 al_id := Find_Alert('Choice_Alert'); 
 al_text := ' Are you sure to generate the batch?';
 Set_Alert_Property(al_id, alert_message_text, al_text);
 al_button := Show_Alert( al_id );
 if al_button != ALERT_BUTTON1 then
 execute_trigger('key-clrfrm');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 end if;

 mandatory_mail(null, :from_date, :to_date, lBatchID);
 if lBatchID is not null then
 :batch_id := lBatchID;
 item_change('pb_run_rep', 'E');
 go_item('pb_run_rep');
 item_change('pb_run_proc', 'D');
 else
 message('Procedure : Mandatory Mail : not run successfully, Contact IS');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;

end;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-BUTTON-PRESSED
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 parameters VARCHAR2(150) := NULL;
 command VARCHAR2(200) := NULL;
 batch_queue rpt_report_names.batch_queue%type;
 temp_return number;
 filename varchar2(100);
 pl_id ParamList; 
 pl_name VARCHAR2(10) := 'dest_parm'; 
 rep_dir varchar2(30);
 al_id alert;
 al_text varchar2(100);
 al_button number;

Begin
 if :batch_id is null then
 show_error('13024');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;

 al_id := Find_Alert('Choice_Alert'); 
 al_text := 'Is printer loaded with Donor Card stationary?';
 Set_Alert_Property(al_id, alert_message_text, al_text);
 al_button := Show_Alert( al_id );
 if al_button = ALERT_BUTTON1 then
 begin
 select parameter_value into rep_dir from valid_parameters
 where parameter_code = 'REPSOURCE' and parameter_type = 'ALL'
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1);

 exception
 when others then
 message('REPSOURCE parameter not defined: Contact IS');pause;
 end;

 filename := 'R:\'||'DCRMAILD'||'_'||:batch_id||'_'||LT_USER_SESSION.get_userid||'.r';

 :system.message_level := 10;
 insert into rpt_parm(appl_id,user_name,report_name,parm_id,parm_date,submit_date,report_status, 
 print_id)
 values('DON',:banner.user_id,'DCRMAILD',:batch_id,sysdate,sysdate,'S',:printer_name);
 
 insert into rpt_parm_select(appl_id,user_name,report_name,parm_id,parm_no,
 parm_select,parm_code)
 values('DON',:banner.user_id,'DCRMAILD',:batch_id,1,:batch_id,'MAILD');

 commit;
 :system.message_level := 0;

 begin 
 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List(pl_name); 
 IF not Id_Null(pl_id) THEN 
 destroy_parameter_list(pl_id) ;
 end if ;

 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List(pl_name); 
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN 
 Message('Error creating parameter list '||pl_name); 
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure; 
 END IF; 
 end; 

 add_parameter(pl_id,'DESTYPE',TEXT_PARAMETER,'FILE');
 add_parameter(pl_id,'DESNAME',TEXT_PARAMETER,filename) ;
 add_parameter(pl_id,'DESFORMAT',TEXT_PARAMETER,NULL);
 add_parameter(pl_id,'P_PARM_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER, :batch_id) ;
 add_parameter(pl_id,'AUTO_PRINT_FLAG',TEXT_PARAMETER,'Y');
 add_parameter(pl_id,'PRINT_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,:printer_name);
 rp2rro.rp2rro_run_product(REPORTS,'DCRMAILD',ASYNCHRONOUS,BATCH,FILESYSTEM,pl_id,null);
 go_item('from_date');
 item_change('pb_run_rep', 'D');
 end if;
End ;
